setup.title: Create the API token
setup.open: Open Atlassian account settings, Security, API tokens, then Create API token.
setup.name: Name the token after this Elysium, and choose how long it lasts.
setup.copy: Copy the token into API token. Atlassian shows it once.
setup.email: Use the email address you sign in to Atlassian with, and the site address you open Jira at.
setup.permissions: The token carries your own permissions, so Elysium reads exactly the projects and boards you can.
